classification.difficultyReason: Find a side by the cosine rule, then check it with the sine rule using the given rounded angle.

content.prompt: Find the length of the missing side to 1 d.p. by using cosine rule, then check your answer using sine rule. The labelled angles may be rounded.

answer.short: $5.4\text{ m}$ by both rules to 1 d.p.
answer.worked:
Cosine rule:
$$\begin{align*}x^2&=5^2+7^2-2(5)(7)\cos50^\circ\\x&=\sqrt{5^2+7^2-2(5)(7)\cos50^\circ}\\x&\approx5.4\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
Sine rule:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{\sin50^\circ}&=\frac{5}{\sin45.3^\circ}\\x&=\frac{5\sin50^\circ}{\sin45.3^\circ}\\x&\approx5.4\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
